content.short: SourceCred is a tool that helps communities incentivize contributors for their work.
content.description: SourceCred provides a credibly neutral framework for measuring and rewarding contributions. It assigns Cred scores to individual contributions and distributes Grain tokens according to those scores. An underlying algorithm assesses how much value a contribution or contributor adds to a project as a whole, rather than counting effort alone. When a contribution arrives, SourceCred identifies the work involved, evaluates its impact on the project's objectives, and credits the author with a precise Cred amount that reflects the value delivered to the collective effort.
content.meta: SourceCred uses Cred scores based on contributions and distributes Grain tokens. Discover SourceCred and other DAO Tools on Lancers Web3 Explorer.
